problem_text: A graph crosses the y-axis at (0, -5). What is the y-intercept?
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the answer is 0, the issue is reading the x-coordinate instead of the y-value. Graph questions need intercepts interpreted from coordinates, not just axis labels.

hint_ladder.title: Y-axis meaning
hint_ladder.prompt: The y-intercept is the y-value where the graph crosses the y-axis.

hint_ladder.title: Read the coordinate
hint_ladder.prompt: For a point on the y-axis, read the second coordinate as the intercept value. The first coordinate only tells you it is on the axis.

hint_ladder.title: Coordinate choice
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is giving 0 because the point is on the y-axis. The intercept value is the y-coordinate.

hint_ladder.title: Intercept routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For a y-intercept, find the point with x = 0 and read the y-value. Use this coordinate; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on reading the second coordinate as the y-intercept when the point lies on the y-axis.
